invariants.rationale: instantTime should be set to a valid (non-empty) string representing an instant to perform the delete operation.
There should be at least one key provided to perform a delete action meaningfully.
A HoodieEngineContext is needed to perform distributed operations.
If keys is provided, all elements in the list should be non-null HoodieKey objects.
If instantTime is set, it should not just be whitespace.
